Complete degeneracy across all 19 folds with zero exposure — this is a null baseline, not a tunable model. No champion file exists.

## Diagnosis

The unified baseline hasn't been initialized with actual model weights or is producing constant outputs. Need to bootstrap a working signal first.

```
aub bootstrap --lane=ost_v62_unified --seed-model=ridge_baseline
```

Your “champion” is effectively **not trading**:

- **exposure_min/max = 0.0 / 0.0** ⇒ weights are all zeros every day.
- **degenerate_folds = [1..19]** ⇒ every OOS fold collapsed (typically “no eligible assets”, “no trades”, “all NaN preds”, or “constraints force zero”).
- **worst_mdd = None** is consistent with “no equity curve because no positions”.

Most common root causes:
1) **Universe filter wipes everything** (liquidity/price/volume/borrowable/locate/halts, etc.).  
2) **Risk/position constraints force zero** (max gross=0, leverage cap=0, max position=0, min trade size too high, turnover cap too low, etc.).  
3) **Predictions are missing/NaN or misaligned** (date shift, symbol mapping, feature join failure).  
4) **Post-processing zeroes weights** (neutralization/group constraints with empty groups, z-scoring on empty slice, clipping to 0, etc.).

### Next Commands (3 lines)

```bash
aub diag --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline --dump eligibility,preds,weights --by-fold
aub run  --lane ost_v62_unified --config configs/relaxed_constraints.yaml --tag sanity_nonzero_exposure
aub report --lane ost_v62_unified --run <new_run_hash> --metrics exposure,trades,eligible_count,nan_pred_rate
```
